courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 動力夯實地盤改良
related.transfer: 可遷移「方格置換面積」與「排水時間尺度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；動力夯實地盤改良的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Square grid replacement area" and "Drainage time scale" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Dynamic compaction of ground must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤；動力夯實地盤改良則以以能量、孔壓與鄰近振動證據評估動力夯實成效為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground; Dynamic compaction of ground centres on evaluate dynamic compaction through energy, pore pressure and neighbouring vibration evidence, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「方格置換面積」與「落錘位能尺度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到動力夯實地盤改良，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「乾密度與含水」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Square grid replacement area” and “Drop weight energy scale”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Dynamic compaction of ground, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Dry density and moisture", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 液化地盤評估與改善
related.transfer: 可遷移「方格置換面積」與「排水時間尺度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；液化地盤評估與改善的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Square grid replacement area" and "Drainage time scale" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Liquefaction assessment and mitigation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤；液化地盤評估與改善則以區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground; Liquefaction assessment and mitigation centres on separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「方格置換面積」與「飽和土有效應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到液化地盤評估與改善，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「改善抗力增幅」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Square grid replacement area” and “Effective stress in saturated soil”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Liquefaction assessment and mitigation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Treatment resistance gain", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 振動碎石樁施工
history.text: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤的背景。美國聯邦公路管理局列出碎石樁設計施工手冊（1985）。基督城南部高速公路開始碎石樁試驗（2010）。地盤改良第一冊收錄粒料柱方法背景（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground. FHWA lists its stone-column design and construction manual (1985). Christchurch Southern Motorway begins stone-column trials (2010). Ground Modification Volume I includes aggregate-column methods (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
